description: Check a Solana wallet's live SPL and Token-2022 token delegates (Solana's version of token approvals, the way drainers move funds): every token account with a delegate, how much it can move, UNLIMITED flag, whether the delegate is a plain wallet, a known program (Jupiter, Raydium, Orca...) or unknown. Also flags held Token-2022 tokens with a permanent delegate and foreign close authorities. Risk level and how to revoke. Costs $0.005.
name: solana_token_delegates
